query: Let `P` be an affine space over a strictly ordered ring `R` with model module `V`, and let `f : StdSimplex R (StdSimplex R P)` be a "simplex of simplices" (a probability distribution over probability distributions over `P`). Then the convex combination of the inner combinations equals the convex combination of the joint distribution: `convexCombination (f.map convexCombination) = convexCombination f.join`.
